smoke.purpose: Fast regression after important controller/model changes.
smoke.expected_structure: Run as 6-8 grouped harnesses with shared setup/cleanup.

core.expected_structure: Run domain packs, usually one harness per pack.

deep.purpose: Targeted edge/regression work after a weakness is found.
deep.selection_rule: Run failed/partial tests, adjacent tests in the same domain, and saved regressions; do not blindly rerun mastered domains.

full.expected_structure: Execute all domain packs; one pack can prove many capabilities. Final integrated missions remain separate autonomous missions.

mastery_policy.domain_mastery: At least 95% across three varied runs, zero manual rescue, zero unsafe mutations, zero controller deadlocks, no repeated failure family.
mastery_policy.rerun_policy: Mastered domains move to smoke sampling unless touched by a relevant controller/model change or a regression reopens them.

packs.execution_strategy: Group compatible cases into one benchmark harness/source with shared setup and cleanup. Use the minimum Play sessions needed for authoritative evidence; do not run every test as a separate Studio mission.
